validation.notes: GitHub Actions post-commit check does not itself guarantee pre-publication blocking without branch protection. The automation performs mandatory pre-publication QA.
validation.additional_requirement: 11 settori GICS nella zona verde e tabella temi separata, con source ID attribuibili alla stessa finestra temporale
additional_requirements: GREEN: exact 30-day rows cover all day-precision records from report date -29 through report date inclusive; supplemented with current/previous month YYYY-MM in distinct green table.
BLUE: historical archive remains full and unfiltered (no blue 30-day window); maintain historical matrices, source cards, full-archive mean date and all IDs.
Month-only YYYY-MM cannot be assigned an invented publication day; day=15 imputation is only for full-archive mean calculations.
Keep five pinned CSS style blocks and 11 GICS sectors in green; sector source IDs must reflect exact 30-day observations.
Do not alter phases 05:00 research and 07:00 HTML/email publication.
Executive Global Outlook header and integrated reading must be before the green 30-day detailed tables; executive charts also before the detailed tables
At least four accessible verified-data visual charts: macro (stance-stacked), publication cadence (non-overlapping time bins), stance shares (30d vs monthly vs history), new view sources
Each chart source-count cross-check must use current validated view data and snapshot changes, avoid mixing month-only with 30-day date-precise counts
Preserve complete original 232/updated historical records, references, CSS SHA, separate green rolling 30-day and blue full archive, and protected private report URL

daily_changes.preferred_reference: Previous calendar day's actually published and validated report

daily_changes.method: Set difference between frozen persisted baselines of consecutive actually published editions. Never equate document publication date with acquisition date. Compare stance only on comparable manager/mandate, instrument, time horizon and primary document; otherwise n.d.
daily_changes.preservation: Append-only prior-edition snapshot saved on successful production; never overwrite old snapshot before comparison
daily_changes.location: Immediately after Executive Investment Outlook and before House Views
daily_changes.display: Four KPI tiles and concise descriptions linking to original sources; do not show a false zero for unassessable changes
daily_changes.no_changes: Explicitly state no verified changes if diffs are actually empty, not if data missing
